title: Mixed Event — The BEST Summer Ever! — Episode8 The Best Summer Ever

meta.Event Outline: The Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy first years arrive at the Seaside School. Finding themselves allocated to the same group for the school's annual presentation event, Honami, Saki, Emu, and Kohane put their showmanship skills to the test by performing a song from a musical.

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A job well done today, everyone!
Do we all have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then here's to winning the silver... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Emu
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It got a little crazy there in the end, but I had so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And we finished in the top 3...? We couldn't ask for more...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Well, I'm a little bummed that we didn't win a trip to that cafe, but cafeteria vouchers are a close second! We should go together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We can exchange it for any one menu item, right? I wonder what I should get...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'm getting a taiyaki☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do they have those at the cafeteria...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, nice work back there.
It was really good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It really was.
I'm glad your hard work paid off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really liked BEST SUMMER too! I think I cried a little when Amy and Dorothy made up!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much... All of you... We couldn't be happier with how it went.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I'm glad we practiced so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The magic show was a nice surprise too. I think we all had some fun there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, what did you think of me being Emu's assistant?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You did really well. The look on your face after each trick was priceless.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean she was just an extension of the audience instead of a show assistant?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're so mean, Shiho!
I had an important role to play!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, Otori, I was amazed to learn that you can perform magic tricks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wish I had been there to see it. I'm sure it was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it wasn't me. It was...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Uh, no...! Nevermind...!
I'm just glad that everyone liked it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Aha, there you all are.
The barbecue's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! That table's covered with all sorts of fish and vegetables! Let's go take a look, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Which should we start with?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna go too!
I wonder if they have steak...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll get some plates ready for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll help, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go get us some more juice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, I'll come with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone.
See you again in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, are we all ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
se_event_summer_2021_005

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, these meats are just about done. Oh, the carrots and bell peppers too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks... Hold on...
Don't you think this is plenty?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is it? Everything looks delicious, so I was making sure you had enough to eat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no way I can eat all of this in one sitting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if I somehow manage to, I'll be back...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane, look!
This scallop's so big!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It is...!
But won't it take a while to cook all the way through?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't know, but here it goes!
se_event_summer_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's split it once it's done.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haruka, the prawns are done!
Order up!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You've been on the grill for a while, Otori. Have you had enough to eat?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
All good☆
Some girls from another group even gave me some rice balls! Should I throw them on here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound good. A light brushing of soy sauce should do the trick.
se_event_summer_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani, Otori, a couple orders of meat just came in. I'll leave them here, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's already getting dark too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was still bright out just a minute ago. Looks like the sun's just about ready to set.
se_event_summer_2021_005

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
There's something I need to do.
I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: O-Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There she goes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um...
Have you seen Emu anywhere?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She ran off in that direction just a second ago. She said she'd be right back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll wait for her here then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Emu, look!
The sea's turned orange! It's so pretty!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is!
It's so beautiful, but kinda sad too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry... I forgot that you don't like sunsets...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I'm over that now! They used to make me sad, but not anymore!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's like you said, Miku. It might be sad now, but we can have fun the next day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm glad I could cheer you up like that. I'll make sure to bring back lots and lots of gifts for everyone too!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I really hope they like it!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Emuuu!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: There you are!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: What are you doing way over there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, hey!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll see you later, Emu.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, we can talk more later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were just about to bake some marshmallows, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun!! I wanna have some!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was about to talk to you at the grill, but you really startled me by running off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry.
I wanted to see the ocean one last time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Look, it's all orange now.
Isn't it pretty?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
It's so romantic. It didn't look like this at all during the day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, this is amazing! I wish it would just stay like this forever...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know what you mean. Seeing a seascape like this makes you want to stay just a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we all have to go home at some point...! Still, we can all think about coming back here someday♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Hona and I have to get back to band practice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Back to pursuing our dream.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be putting on more shows, and I'm gonna give everyone extra-big smiles!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'll be performing at events too...!
I need to get back to singing practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, Team Silver, ready to bake some marshmallows?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, come back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, sorry!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shall we...?

rows.Speaker: Honami & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We all have somewhere to be, but I'm so glad that we were able to do our performance in the end. It was so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope the four of us get a chance to do this again, someday...)
